title: As Amtrak seeks to expand, restructure rail service, congressional support remains a question
summary: The railroad’s board of directors looks to address growing ridership, but future funding hangs on the stalled congressional surface transportation legislation.

title: After rent emergency declaration, San Francisco mayor proposes reforms
summary: As an AI boom pushes median rents higher, Mayor Daniel Lurie is proposing $30 million in investments and reforms to curb rising evictions and “sudden rent spikes.”

title: The ‘next 9/11’ may not look like 9/11, former FDNY fire chief says
summary: Prepare for a new generation of threats, including climate disasters, says Joseph Pfeifer, who went on to found the fire department’s Center for Terrorism and Disaster Preparedness.

title: 2026 Smart Cities Dive Community Project Award Winners: Solving real community needs
summary: Addressing energy costs, housing, transportation and community engagement, these initiatives exemplify the innovation that helps cities and counties improve residents’ lives.

title: EV car-sharing and curbside charging network expands clean transportation in Minnesota’s Twin Cities
summary: The EV Spot Network may be the nation’s first municipally-owned car-sharing and clean-energy-powered curbside charging program. It’s a 2026 Smart Cities Dive Community Project Award winner.

title: Renters benefit from energy-efficient appliances through Orlando program
summary: This Smart Cities Dive Community Project Award winner puts portable energy-saving technology in low-income residents’ hands, reaching renters and homeowners overlooked by most efficiency programs.

title: The Smart Cities Dive Awards
summary: To highlight notable people and projects in U.S. city, county and regional government, Smart Cities Dive presents the Public Service Awards and the Community Project Awards.

title: Participatory budgeting behind bars: Durham, North Carolina, gives incarcerated residents a say
summary: This 2026 Smart Cities Dive Community Project Award-winning program invites people in the county jail to weigh in on municipal spending. One resident told officials it restored his humanity.

title: How one Florida county is using data to help vulnerable residents keep their homes
summary: An early-warning system in Jacksonville, Florida, uses AI to protect generational housing from institutional investors. The initiative is a 2026 Smart Cities Dive Community Project Award winner.

title: AI transparency is key for local governments, residents say
summary: Residents' comfort with AI use in local government is holding steady, but rollouts must be thoughtful, a PayIt survey found.
